study type: Observational analytic study with a cross-sectional approach
outcome: Provision of colostrum to newborns by the cesarean delivery method
cohort: 138 post-cesarean mothers in May-June 2018 at Hospital Government at Banten, Indonesia
finding: Intention of breastfeeding, support of health workers, husband's support, and knowledge are jointly related to the provision of colostrum to newborns by the cesarean delivery method.
